designationHistory.indexText: Air Force takes control. 2009 January 6 - The Pacific Islands Heritage Marine National Monument is established, which expanded the protected boundaries of Johnston Atoll out to 50 miles. 2010 - U.S.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
